title: Bent Pyramid
visualBrief: Surviving Dahshur Bent Pyramid:188m square lower footprint, steep pale limestone casing to47.04m, abrupt shallower upper slope to104.71m, weathered/exposed stone patches and ragged dark crown, small north/west passage mouths. Main pyramid only; satellite pyramid, enclosure, temples, causeway, access stairs and interior chambers excluded.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Native cardinal pyramid footprint centroid; standard unmodified Terrarium source heights referenced to dry desert160m east. Native footprint cutout removes pyramid returns only beneath actual masonry. Coarse DEM retains artificial pyramid-return mounds outside that ring; geographic placement is approximate and does not certify excavation-level contact. Portable asset stage uses a flat floor for geometry inspection.

terrainReference.basis: Dry desert160m east of center, beyond the smoothed pyramid return at110m. External reference selected before first rendering; source heights and masonry shape unchanged.

groundCutout.basis: Native main-pyramid ring only, fully beneath the physical188m masonry shell; removes pyramid DEM returns without changing original source heights.

geographicProposal.notes: Native main-pyramid polygon retained. Cardinal orientation fixed; portal offsets and original excavation level remain approximate.

limitations: Approximate surviving188m base and104.71m overall height; native mapped plan is coarser/narrower and remains the geographic control. Native building-part47.04m breakpoint adopted; article rounds this to49m. No survey claim.

One inspected clear public-domain Qualla panorama controls identifying pale casing, bend and dark weathered crown. Stone loss/color patch positions, hidden faces and exact portal depths are medium-fi interpretations; original pixels are not textures.

The coarse source DEM has artificial pyramid returns outside the native cutout and may obscure lower casing in geographic views. This is a recorded host-terrain limitation; pyramid geometry is not fitted to it.

Main pyramid exterior only. Satellite pyramid and detached structures, enclosure/causeway, modern visitor stair and interior are excluded. Footing extends1m below visualization datum; no fitted terrain platform or reshaped elevation field.
